Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:
We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) — the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure).
This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side — building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time.
SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers — Support, Consulting, Presales — and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket.
You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery).
Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:
• 
 Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers — Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose — along with their documentation.
• 
Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment.
• 
Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized — not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases.
• 
Take part in the team's shared medic rotation and resolve engineering-level support cases, feeding learnings back into development.
• 
Contribute to the shared tooling (review, deployment, and test tooling) that SMX is building so other Camunda teams can adopt it — this is one of the team's current investment areas.
What success looks like (first ~3 months):
• 
Taken on your first medic rotation slot and support tickets to understand the stack, customer challenges, and deployment environments.
• 
Improved onboarding or documentation, turning your own ramp-up experience into concrete improvements.
• 
Contributed to artifact fixes, CI/CD enhancements, or test automation that strengthens release quality.
• 
Deliver structural improvement initiatives — a feature request, or a test/release improvement.
• 
Built working relationships with engineering, QA, and product peers, and started building context on the reference-architecture side of the team.
• 
Started forming your own view of a customer pain point from firsthand signal (support tickets, consulting feedback), not just from a ticket description.
What You Bring:
• 
Ability and/or willingness to use our product, with genuine curiosity about the customer problem behind a ticket — comfortable asking "should we build this" as well as "how do we build this."
• 
Strong expertise in building, operating, and maintaining Helm Charts; deploying applications on Kubernetes; implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
• 
Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively across teams.
• 
A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem-solving.
• 
You thrive as a manager of one — you build it, you own it — and take pride in delivering maintainable, operable software.
 Nice-to-haves:
• 
Experience running and operating on-prem/self-hosted software on Docker.
• 
Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tools.
• 
Working knowledge of the Go programming language.
• 
Exposure to cloud infrastructure/IaC (Terraform, Crossplane) — useful as SMX moves toward shared review capability across installation artifacts and reference architectures.

22f2bfee7d275abd.description: **About Dentira** Dentira is one of the fastest-growing, profitable healthcare startups revolutionizing clinic operations across multiple countries. Our flagship product transformed dental procurement by introducing the world's first real-time price and product comparison engine for dental supplies in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. Building on this success, our latest innovation, the Lab Platform, streamlines case creation and management by seamlessly connecting clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs. We're also pioneering the use of advanced AI to tackle complex problems like automatic invoice reconciliation and procedure cost prediction — capabilities we're extending across the healthcare verticals we serve. As we continue to expand, we are actively exploring adjacent verticals and new avenues for growth while strengthening our presence in existing ones. Our ambitious goal is to achieve over 10X growth within the next 3 years. **About the Role** We are looking for a Group Product Manager to join our dynamic and fast-paced team. In this role you will shape the future of our flagship product in healthcare procurement and be responsible for driving marketplace growth, managing entire procure-to-pay lifecycle for our customers while improving user experience and engagement. As a Group Product Manager for our Procurement product, you will own the end-to-end experience for our clinics from procurement to invoicing. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, product excellence and cross functional execution. You will own the decisions for major product investments, translating ambiguous problems into a structured product strategy and defensible roadmap. This is a player-coach role. You will manage a small team of PMs while also contributing in an individual capacity. You'll set multi-quarter strategy and defensible roadmaps, translate ambiguous business problems into clear execution plans, and represent your charter in executive and cross-functional forums — while staying close enough to the details to make good calls on trade-offs, experiments, and edge cases. This role suits a senior product leader with the vision to shape long-term direction, the judgment to operate in complex cross-functional environments, and the experience to lead a team of PMs. You'll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Sales, Strategy, and Account Management across Dentira's geographies. Your work will be informed by rich customer insights, feedback, experimentation and a strong understanding of marketplaces. You’ll combine product intuition with analytical rigor to build a healthcare procurement platform that delivers value to business while creating a delightful experience for our customers. 22bd6501f7e18e0d.description: ## **About the DSML Team** The Data Science and Machine Learning (DSML) team owns the full lifecycle of Prodigal's ML systems, from data curation to model selection, fine-tuning, and post-training, through to deployment, evaluation, and ongoing monitoring. We sit close to real product and customer problems, and we're expected to move from experiment to production with both speed and rigor. ## **What You'll Do** - **Understand the problem domain.** Work closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous, real-world problems into well-scoped ML problems. - **Curate datasets.** Source, clean, and structure the data needed to train and evaluate models, often before any "off-the-shelf" dataset exists. - **Train models across the full spectrum.** Build and train everything from simple classifiers to neural networks, transformers, and small/large language models, choosing the right level of complexity for the problem at hand. - **Deploy and scale for inference.** Take models from notebook to production. optimizing for latency, cost, and reliability at scale. - **Evaluate and close the loop.** Design evaluation frameworks that actually measure what matters, and build learning loops. ## **What You Bring** - Strong fundamentals in ML/DL, backed by hands-on experience training and shipping models, not just coursework or competitions. - High agency, you take an ambiguous problem and run with it rather than waiting for it to be fully specified. - A first-principles approach to problem-solving – you reason from the ground up rather than defaulting to whatever's fashionable or familiar. - Genuine curiosity and the comfort to operate at the edge of what you already know. ## **Job Benefits:** - **World-class team** - You'll get the chance to learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll ever meet. Our team members have been part of BCG, Deloitte, EY, Blackstone, Meta, Amazon and are IIT, IIM, BITS alumnus. - **Continuous education** - As relentless seekers of knowledge, we sponsor and support any training materials, books, courses, and exam fees for upskilling yourself in areas related to your role - but that's not where it ends. If you make a good case for some extra learning, we're delighted to foot the tab. - **Food at the office** – Meals are on us. We won't let your stomach grumble while you hustle. - **Health insurance** - Health always comes first. The health of your family is as important to us, as it is to you. We offer insurance coverage for both you and your family. - **Flexible schedule** - We're not a "clock in, clock out" company. Morning person? Start work while the world's still sleeping. Night owl? Ramp things up while others are winding down. You're fully trusted to create the right conditions for your own personal peak productivity. We only ask that you be available to your teammates for seamless collaboration. - **Generous leave policy** - Take all the time you need to recharge your batteries - no cap on vacation allowance here. Because a rested, relaxed, and refreshed mind is a happy and effective mind. - **Recreation & team activities** – We regularly indulge in friendly football, table tennis, pickle ball, team dinner and challenge each other to do those extra push ups or chug that 4th drink (of course that’s Nimbu Pani)
